stem.text: The relative magnitude of the property X of five elements is shown. P, Q, R, S and T are all in Period 3 and have consecutive atomic numbers.
The letters are **not** the actual chemical symbols of the elements.

stem.alt: Graph of property X (y-axis) against atomic number (x-axis) for five elements P, Q, R, S and T. X rises from P to Q, peaks sharply at R, falls steeply to S, then rises slightly to T.
